name: Stripe MCP (remote)
description: Stripe-hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.stripe.com. Exposes read and write Stripe API tools; Stripe requires human confirmation for some write actions such as refunds and outbound payments.

provenance.notes: Registry entry com.stripe/mcp version 0.2.4, status active, published 2025-10-28, remotes streamable-http https://mcp.stripe.com; domain namespace com.stripe. Supports version, transport. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

Stripe docs: two auth methods, OAuth and agent API keys (Bearer); from December 2026 full-access secret keys and untagged restricted keys stop working (migrate by 2026-11-30); stripe_api_write tool; human confirmation for certain writes; advice to enable client tool approval and beware prompt injection. Supports auth_methods. auth_methods records the credential types the server accepts from the client or its environment: oauth2 = MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1) or an upstream OAuth login; api_key = a static bearer/personal/agent token passed by header or environment variable.
